in_sanskrit.name: Jasmin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Given by the gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jasmin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jasmin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jasmine' which means 'Given by the gods'. It is a name of great significance in Hindu culture and is often associated with the beauty, gentleness, and grace of nature.

in_hindi.name: जस्मिन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Jasmin in Hindi is derived from the name of the Jasmine flower, which is जस्मिन् (jasmin) in Sanskrit. The name Jasmin is not a native Sanskrit or Hindi name, but it is commonly used in India and has cultural significance due to the popularity of the Jasmine flower.
